product_verification: Decimal products compared at70-significant-digit precision with absolute tolerance1e-25 USD for C#96-bit decimal rounding; all event dates, factors and amounts remain exact.
scope: Native LEAN factor/map/event APIs over existing retrospective sample files. No orders, position accounting, strategy scoring, dataset acquisition or historical first-observation claim.
price_convention: Raw bundled integer OHLC divided by10000; exported factors/prices are invariant-culture decimal text. Adjusted prices use full-file factors. ScaledRaw fixes an explicit endDateTime basis; this is an adjustment convention, not proof that original factor metadata was available then.
dividend_convention: Native GetSplitsAndDividends event distribution is retained in native units with its raw reference-price date and factor ratio. No distribution is multiplied by holdings or combined with a price-return label.
total_return_convention: GetPriceFactor(TotalReturn) supplies the native split factor; a total-return price series also needs dividend accumulation. This probe does not report a total-return series or cash P&L.
guards: Reject an implicit ScaledRaw basis using upstream ArgumentException
Reject a requested bar after its claimed decision cutoff in the adapter
Require the native mapped symbol to match AAPL
